title: Mollification: C¹ approximants on Q_δ with total gradient at most V converging in L¹
statement: Let m ∈ ℕ, n := m + 1, Q₁ := (0,1)ⁿ and Q_δ := {y : δ < y_i < 1 − δ for all i} in Euclid n (Lebesgue measure), div g := trace Dg. Let u : ℝⁿ → ℝ be integrable on Q₁ and V ∈ ℝ with ∫_{Q₁} u · div g ≤ V for every C^∞ map g : ℝⁿ → ℝⁿ with compact support, tsupport g ⊆ Q₁ and |g| ≤ 1. Then for every δ > 0 there are C¹ functions v_k : ℝⁿ → ℝ (k ∈ ℕ) with ∫_{Q_δ} ‖Dv_k‖ ≤ V for all k and ∫_{Q_δ} |v_k − u| → 0 as k → ∞.
lean_statement: ∀ (m : ℕ) (u : Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ) (V δ : ℝ), IntegrableOn u {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ g : Euclid (m + 1) → Euclid (m + 1), ContDiff ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) g → HasCompactSupport g → tsupport g ⊆ {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1} → (∀ y, ‖g y‖ ≤ 1) → ∫ y in {y : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, 0 < y i ∧ y i < 1}, u y * LinearMap.trace ℝ (Euclid (m + 1)) (fderiv ℝ g y) ≤ V) → 0 < δ → ∃ v : ℕ → Euclid (m + 1) → ℝ, (∀ k, ContDiff ℝ 1 (v k)) ∧ (∀ k, ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, ‖fderiv ℝ (v k) x‖ ≤ V) ∧ Tendsto (fun k => ∫ x in {z : Euclid (m + 1) | ∀ i, δ < z i ∧ z i < 1 - δ}, |v k x - u x|) atTop (𝓝 0)
